title: 第9章 第二职业第10章 第二天赋这是污蔑
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
苏醒坐在那张睡了整整三年的硬板床上，正低头收拾着寥寥无几的私人物品。
其实根本没什么可收拾的——原身父母留下的几件不值钱的小首饰、一张边角已经磨损的合照，还有几本翻烂了的旧书。
说白了，都是些半点实用价值都没有的念想。
但为了维持“失忆后仍怀念过去”
的这个人设，苏醒还是特意回来一趟，准备把这些东西带走。
“全哥，你真的……觉醒战斗职业了？”
一个声音在旁边怯怯地响起，带着难以置信和浓浓的羡慕。
“嗯。”
苏醒头也没抬，简单地应了一声。
说话的是叶凡，大家都叫他小叶子，一个注定应该是主角的人。
年纪和苏醒相仿，身世也差不多，都是三年前那场惨烈保卫战留下的孤儿，同样在这和平饭店的底层挣扎求存。
“全哥，你走了，我就惨了……”
叶凡的声音带上了哭腔，一屁股坐在苏醒旁边。
“杨永信那个王八蛋，以后就逮着我一个人欺负了！”
杨永信，也是孤儿出身，但他比苏醒和叶凡幸运些，至少还有几个叔叔伯伯在饭店里干活。
这点微不足道的靠山，却足以让他在同龄的仆役中作威作福，成了个小霸王。
苏醒刚来时连话都说不利索，没少受他欺负。
直到苏醒咬牙坚持那所谓的“琦玉训练法”
一年后，身体结实了，才反过来把杨永信揍得不敢再招惹他。
“他不会的，他不敢。”

苏醒停下手中的动作，转过头，看着叶凡认真地说，“你是我朋友，他不敢动你。
他要是再欺负你，你就来告诉我。”
这是他的承诺，叶凡和他同住这间小屋三年，最初那段最难熬的日子里，两人互相帮衬着才挺过来，这份情谊是真实的。
“听说……杨永信那家伙也觉醒了，是个厨师职业，被调到副楼的厨房帮厨去了，应该……应该不会回来欺负我了。”
叶凡小声补充了一句，像是自我安慰。
随即，他话锋一转，眼中闪烁着期盼又忐忑的光芒，问出了心底最纠结的问题：
“全哥，你说……我要不要也去试试觉醒啊？那50金币的祝福药水……真的有必要喝吗？太贵了……”
苏醒看着眼前少年那混合着渴望与恐惧的眼神，放下了手中的杂物。
他深吸一口气，用自己从书上看来的、以及刚刚亲身体验的认知回答道：
“一定要买。”
他的语气异常肯定，“根据《觉醒闲谈》那本书里说的，觉醒仪式平均只有22%的人能成功觉醒出职业。
但这22%的成功者里，超过九成都是喝了祝福药水的！”
他顿了顿，让这个数字沉淀一下，然后继续盯着叶凡的眼睛，说得更仔细：
“而在所有觉醒职业者中，只有大约一成的人，能觉醒出战斗职业。
而几乎所有觉醒出战斗职业的人——九成九！
——都喝了药水。”
苏醒把手重重地搭在叶凡瘦削的肩膀上，目光灼灼：
“小叶子，人这一生，只有一次觉醒的机会。
content_en:
Su Xing sat on the hard bed that he had slept on for three years, lowering his head to pack his few personal belongings.
In fact, there was nothing to deal with at all - a few worthless jewelry left by the original parents, a photo with frayed corners, and a few torn old books.
To put it bluntly, they are all thoughts with no practical value at all.
But in order to maintain "I still miss the past after amnesia"
With this character, Su Xing came back specially to take these things away.
"Brother Quan, have you really... awakened to the combat profession?"
A voice sounded timidly from the side, with disbelief and deep envy.
"Yeah."
Su Xing simply responded without raising his head.
The person who spoke was Ye Fan, everyone called him Xiao Zizi, a person who was destined to be the protagonist.
He is similar in age to Su Xing and has similar life experience. They are both orphans left behind in the tragic defense battle three years ago. They are also struggling to survive on the ground floor of the Peace Hotel.
"Brother Quan, if you leave, I will be miserable..."
Ye Fan's voice was filled with tears and he sat down next to Su Xing.
"That bastard Yang Yongxin will bully me alone from now on!"
Yang Yongxin was also an orphan, but he was luckier than Su Xing and Ye Fan. At least he still had a few uncles working in the restaurant.
This insignificant backing was enough for him to dominate among the servants of the same age and become a little bully.
When Su Xing first came here, he couldn't even speak well and was bullied by him a lot.
Until Su Xing gritted his teeth and insisted on the so-called "Saitama training method"
A year later, when his body became stronger, he beat Yang Yongxin so hard that he didn't dare to provoke him again.
"He won't, he doesn't dare."
Su Xing stopped what he was doing, turned his head, looked at Mark and said seriously, "You are my friend, he doesn't dare to touch you.
If he bullies you again, come and tell me. "
This was his promise. Ye Fan had lived with him in this cabin for three years. During the first, most difficult days, the two of them helped each other to survive. This friendship was real.
"I heard...that guy Yang Yongxin has also awakened. He is a chef by profession. He was transferred to the kitchen of the auxiliary building to help cook. He should...should not come back to bully me."
Ye Fan added in a low voice, as if to comfort himself.
Immediately, he changed the topic, his eyes shone with hope and anxiety, and asked the most troubling question in his heart:
"Brother Quan, tell me...should I also try to awaken? That 50 gold coin blessing potion...is it really necessary to drink it? It's too expensive..."
Su Xing looked at the eyes of the young man in front of him that were mixed with desire and fear, and put down the things in his hands.
He took a deep breath and answered using his knowledge from books and personal experience:
"Must buy it."
His tone was unusually sure, "According to the book "Awakening Chat", on average, only 22% of people in the awakening ceremony can successfully awaken their profession.
But among the 22% of successful people, more than 90% drank the blessing potion! "
He paused to let the number settle, then continued to stare into Ye Fan's eyes and spoke more carefully:
"Among all those who have awakened their profession, only about 10% can awaken the combat profession.
And almost all people who have awakened to the combat profession - 99%!
——They all drank the potion. "
Su Xing placed his hands heavily on Ye Fan's thin shoulders, his eyes burning:
"Little Ye Zi, there is only one chance to awaken in this life.
